snippet.title: Storage 8 VR | Find The Anomalies Before The Mannequin Finds You!
snippet.description:
We all love Storage Wars. Seeing the weird stuff that people keep locked away from the world. Until it fights back. Until the mannequin you left in the back corner starts a boy band. ...wait what?
Want to support the channel and get cheaper games? Save 10% on all Meta Quest Games by using code ‘AWOLFINVR’ at checkout.
Join the Pack! ➤ https://bit.ly/2C8V0mE

A Wolf in VR Merch: https://www.teespring.com/stores/awolfinvr

Intro Movie: "Split" (2016)

This game was played on: Quest 3S (PCVR)


In Storage8, you move through a familiar storage area and pay attention to small details along the way. Some things may feel out of place. Some things may not be exactly as you remember. When the space feels unfamiliar, turn back. When it feels unchanged, continue forward. Your goal is simple: Find your way out.

Storage 8 VR: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4771190/Storage_8_VR/
